bias.zh: 偏空 · 反弹逼近 200 日均线

read.en: Arm rose 1.5% on Oct 27 to $226.60, trading between $222.01 and $227.83. It is above the falling 5-day ($219.4) and 10-day ($225.7), just below the rising 200-day ($227.2), and below the falling 30-day ($268.8) and 100-day ($284.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 7 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Sep 28 ($235.25), and RSI is 40.
read.zh: Arm 10月27日上涨 1.5%，收于 $226.60，盘中区间 $222.01–227.83。股价位于下行的 5 日（$219.4）和 10 日均线（$225.7）上方，略低于上行的 200 日均线（$227.2），并低于下行的 30 日（$268.8）和 100 日均线（$284.6）。MACD 自 10月7日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 9月28日起看空（$235.25），RSI 为 40。

read.en: The close cleared $225.6–226 (Oct 26 high, 10-day), now support, but the $227.8 high could not hold above the 200-day. Resistance is $227.2–229 (200-day, Oct 21 high), then $235.3 (SAR) and $238–239.4 (Sep 14 low, Oct 16 high). Support is $222–225.7, then $217.3–219.4 (5-day, Aug 3 and Oct 20 lows) and $208.3. A close above $229 would target $235–238; below $222, $218.

s.en: 10-day average $225.7; Oct 26 high $225.7, now support; Oct 27 low $222.0
